events.description: The Gravel Roll is BACK! Hollerin' for more in Walhalla in 2026! Guaranteed to make you whoop, The Holler in Walhalla is our mountain gravel race for the Gravel Roll in 2025. events.title: Pisgah Monster-Cross Challenge
events.description: The Pisgah Monster-Cross Challenge is the premiere all-road racing event in the region. Participants are challenged to complete a 69.2 mile course with 8,777’of climbing along scenic gravel and paved roads. The riders will be treated to some of the finest gravel roads in the Pisgah and Nantahala National Forests, which is a one-of-a-kind opportunity in the racing world. Monster-Cross is a dream gravel endurance event where keen race tactics and strategy, along with overall fitness, proper gear selection, and sheer luck are key to success. There will be three Rest Areas along the way that will be stocked with water, food (PB&J, fruit, salty snacks, sweet snacks, bars), first aid, and neutral mechanical support. events.title: Pisgah 111 / 555
events.description: It’s time to turn the volume up to 111! The Pisgah 111 is the quintessential crusher of a cross-country endurance MTB race. Racers follow a 65.1 mile course with 10,200' feet of climbing along the most iconic trails and gravel roads known in Pisgah National Forest. Just peek at the course map and list of trails and you’ll immediately get chills just thinking about the epic scenery and terrain you’ll encounter. This is a true mountain bike race with no map reading skills required, just follow the arrows. Think of it as the most exciting (and grueling) tour of Pisgah you can imagine during the peak of the leaves changing in the forest. events.title: Pisgah DOUBLE DARE
events.description: Every year an event comes along that tests mental and physical strengths of its racers like no other. Pisgah Productions proudly presents the hardest (and most fun) thing you will do this year….. the DOUBLE DARE. Teams of two riders will race to reach up to 10 checkpoints (CPs) per day, two days in a row. The race begins at 10AM on Saturday and every team must be back before 10PM. The race resumes at 6AM Sunday with 10 brand new checkpoints. Every team must finish before 6PM on Sunday. Teams ‘in the running’ should expect up to 70 miles of riding with 12,000-15,000 feet of climbing each day. SINGLE-DARE! The one-day category at Double-Dare!!! events.title: Bootlegger
events.description: The Bootlegger is one of the most challenging and scenic gravel events of the year! There are two route choices (58 and 85 miles) that both start and finish in downtown Lenoir, NC and travel through the beautiful and rugged Wilson Creek Gorge. The 58 mile route has approximately 4500 feet of climbing while the 85 includes approximately 7250 feet of climbing. Be sure to keep your head up and enjoy the scenery as the Bootlegger 100 takes you from historic downtown Lenoir and into the heart of the “other Pisgah,” also known as the Grandfather Ranger District. Both the 85 and 58 mile options roll through the countryside before delivering you to a gravel wonderland with plenty of challenging terrain. events.title: Pisgah Mountain Bike Adventure Race
events.description: The Pisgah Mountain Bike Adventure Race (PMBAR) is the absolute pinnacle of MTB Adventure Racing. A mix of brutal and beautiful, this test of spirit and camaraderie tasks teams of two racers to reach 4 of 5 checkpoints, in any order, and return to the start/finish as fast as possible. The team with the lowest overall time wins. Checkpoint locations remain secret until start-time and there is no suggested route. Routes vary between 50-80 miles, include 9,000-15,000 feet of climbing, and take 7-14 hours to complete. PMBAR is held deep in the Pisgah National Forest, one of the most beautiful, rugged, and unforgiving areas in the nation. There will be little to no water or food support on course.
